title: I Wish it Could be Halloween Every Day
description: Allows halloween mobs - mobs that wear jack o' lanterns or pumpkins - to spawn year round!
body:
Normally halloween mobs can only spawn during... halloween, this mod changes it to make them spawn 24/7, great for your mob collection needs!

Im gonna add 1.13 and 1.21 eventually once I need them, so I guess watch out for that.
